about: The witnesses of the reference values: packages that compute the same numbers outside Tabularia, run by hand by make_reference.py with uv on these pins («python»; «closure» is what uv resolved besides them on 2026-11-22) (docs/specs/foundation-forecast.md, «Self-test, reference values, witnesses»). The official, unmodified `timestral` package is installed from the Git commit; the weights are read from a local directory filled once from the pinned revisions and checked by sha256 (never committed). Never installed in the group's image; not part of the recipe, so changing them builds nothing.
